newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air France says October FTKs up 0.1 pct.
newsitem.headline: Air France says October FTKs up 0.1 pct.

text.p: Air France recorded a 0.1 percent rise in global cargo traffic in October, compared to the same month last year, with 418.3 million freight tonne kilometres (FTK) figures issued by the carrier show.
This is the smallest gain since April 1996 when Air France transported 398.5 million FTK, down 3.7 percent on the same month in 1995.
The FTK measurement is derived by multiplying the weight of cargo carried by the distance flown.
In September Air France reported 12.9 percent growth on September 1995, transporting 434.9 million FTK
The overall cargo load factor in October 1996 was down 3.5 percentage points on the same month last year at 67.6 percent, the French state airline added.
No comment was immediately available from Air France on the October figures.

In the first seven months of its current financial year -- which runs from April 1 1996 to March 31 1997 -- Air France transported 2.81 billion FTK, up 5.8 percent on April-October 1995, the airline said.

Overall cargo load factor during April-October 1996 was down 0.3 percentage points on the previous year's levels at 67.3 percent, Air France added. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
